purpose: Prevent silent schema drift across the historical MO quote-delivery window before any event-conditioned option outcome is inspected.
source_family: CIIS official distribution of CFFEX historical Level-2 data

evidence.documented_transition: The 2026 CIIS manual states that legacy CFFEX Snapshot delivery naming/layout is no longer provided from 2024-07-08 onward and points to the newer StockTick/current standardized delivery convention.

epochs.mapping_rule: Use a source-specific mapping proven from the delivered legacy files/dictionary. Do not infer array expansion from bracket notation alone.
Use a separate source-specific mapping proven from the post-transition files/dictionary. Do not assume column identity with the legacy Snapshot layout.
Inventory separately under the existing prospective data-role freeze and validate any subsequent format changes before canonicalization.

canonicalization_rule: Each physical epoch must independently map and validate contract_code, timestamp, bid1, bid1_size, ask1, ask1_size, last_price, volume, open_interest, trading_status, and contract-master expiry before concatenation into the common canonical schema.
cross_epoch_rule: No concatenation is allowed until both historical epochs have source-specific PASS-level schema/provenance checks. A PASS for one epoch cannot waive unresolved fields in another epoch.
event_join_rule: No R1_B event timestamps may be joined to either epoch during schema discovery or admission.
